audit_items.proof_trace: ComputeCells wrapper trusts external c-kzg-4844 library without validating output length equals CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB (128). While downstream validation at das_core.go:227-232 provides defense-in-depth by checking columnIndex bounds, the wrapper itself does not enforce the post-condition. If the external library has a bug returning <128 cells, downstream bounds check will error; if >128, excess cells are silently ignored.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If c-kzg-4844 library has implementation bug or is compromised to return incorrect cell count, system processes malformed data. For <128 cells: bounds check errors propagate causing validation failures. For >128 cells: excess data silently discarded, potentially masking library corruption. Property violation allows undetected library malfunction to corrupt blob reconstruction.
